chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen Massacres the Yecha Clan to Lure Their King
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen, as a Purple Diamond skeleton, launches a brutal assault on the Yecha clan in Luoyang to draw out the Yecha King and save his friends. Overseas, the Hundred Races' true power is revealed.
og_title: Skeleton's Wrath: Xiao Chen Butchers the Night Shura Clan
og_description: Desperate to rescue his companions, Xiao Chen slaughters Yecha warriors in Luoyang and threatens their king. Meanwhile, the vast overseas territories of the Hundred Races emerge.
twitter_title: Xiao Chen Goes on a Rampage Against the Yecha Clan
twitter_description: In a bold move to protect his friends, Xiao Chen massacres the Yecha clan in Luoyang and sets his sights overseas, revealing the true extent of the Hundred Races.
